status: CANDIDATE. Drafted as a starting point. Every threshold and action is a placeholder until a sports scientist keeps, changes or deletes it. No rule is validated, and the evidence field is empty until a citation is added.
inputs: rpe_delta = session RPE minus target RPE. sleep_h = hours slept. soreness and stress are 0-10 athlete ratings. note = free text.

rules.name: Short sleep, two nights
rules.trigger: sleep_h below 6 on each of the last 2 nights
rules.action: Reduce working-set volume 10-20%. Keep prescribed intensity.

rules.name: Sustained RPE overshoot
rules.trigger: rpe_delta of +2 or more on 3 of the last 4 sessions
rules.action: Reduce load or volume for the next session. Coach chooses which.

rules.name: High local soreness
rules.trigger: soreness 7 or above in a muscle group the planned session loads heavily
rules.action: Swap or reduce the main exercise for that group. Leave other exercises unchanged.

rules.name: High stress, poor sleep
rules.trigger: stress 8 or above and sleep_h below 6.5 on the same day
rules.action: Reduce volume 10%. Flag to coach for a conversation.

rules.name: Return after missed sessions
rules.trigger: no completed sessions in the last 7 days
rules.action: Do not progress load. Consider a reduced-volume re-entry session.

rules.name: Illness note
rules.trigger: note reports fever, chest symptoms or acute illness
rules.action: Propose rest. Flag to coach. No exercise edits.

rules.name: Pain or injury note
rules.trigger: note reports pain, injury or a sharp or joint-specific symptom
rules.action: No automatic edit. Flag to coach for clearance.

rules.name: Normal fluctuation
rules.trigger: rpe_delta within +/-1, sleep_h 6.5 or above, soreness 5 or below, stress 6 or below

rules.name: Consistently under target
rules.trigger: rpe_delta of -2 or lower on 3 of the last 4 sessions and no other flags
rules.action: Suggest a load increase within the coach's progression limits. Never above the plan's ceiling.

rules.name: Deload week
rules.trigger: planned session is in a deload week
rules.action: No change unless R6 or R7 applies.
